values.source: Localizable.strings: Add Row / Commit / Discard / Paste to Selected Cells

values.name: inline cell editing
values.value: Dataloom: double-click a cell to edit in place; Enter or clicking away saves, Escape cancels; views and keyless tables stay read-only
values.source: Dataloom choice: custom-painted grid places a TextEdit in the cell and writes through Db::update_cell; the original edits cells inside TableContentTable (nib) and exposes Add Row / Commit / Discard / Paste to Selected Cells

values.name: export sql
values.value: Dataloom: one table or the whole database as CREATE + one INSERT per row; the original also offers DROP IF EXISTS, structure-only, content-only and gzip options
values.source: ViewSetting -> ExportTableSQLNotIncludeStruct, ExportTableSQLNotIncludeContent, ExportTableSQLDropIfExist, ExportTableSQLCompressGzip, ExportFileNamePatterns, ExportTableCSV*; Dataloom: Db::dump_table_sql / dump_database_sql with values quoted by the engine

values.name: import sql
values.value: Dataloom: runs every statement of a .sql file against the connection
values.source: Original menu strings From SQL Dump... and Import SQL Wizard; Dataloom: Db::import_sql through split_statements

values.name: backups
values.value: Dataloom: on-demand timestamped backup per connection in the app data folder, byte-for-byte file copy for SQLite and SQL dump for server engines; SQLite copies restore in place
values.source: Original: BackupDatabaseChecklist, BackupHistoryWindow, BackupRunner, BackupScheduleFormController, BackupFileNamePatterns, Backup database (Legacy)... menu item, Use Sync database, a new replacement for Backup.; Dataloom: db::create_backup / list_backups / restore_backup
